title: Urgency: Crash AAPS after update samsung One UI 4.1
symptom: After a Samsung update to One UI 4.1 (Android 12), AAPS crashes and cannot be used. The user reports the crash occurs on versions 3.0.0.1 and 3.0.0.2.
fix: The user resolved the issue by clearing the app cache and force stopping the app, then quickly pressing the next button to unlock the situation and prevent the crash. Another suggestion was to delete all files and folders, backup parameters, delete database, uninstall AAPS, reboot, reinstall, and set parameters without backup.
evidence_quote: after removing the cache and stopping force of the app I had the time a few seconds press the next button which allowed to unlock the situation and not crash the application anymore
